checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are accurate and rigorous. The image clearly depicts a vintage typewriter with round keys, failing every geometric and functional checkpoint for a 'space bar' (which must be elongated, rectangular, flat/concave, and blank). The Router correctly marked the defining features as absent. The only 'present' checkpoints were weak contextual matches (color, being part of a keyboard), which do not save the alignment score given the total semantic mismatch.
artifact_review: The Router identified 'text_gibberish' (mirrored text) and 'structural_collapse' (muddy typebars). The Image Text Auditor confirmed low-confidence extraction ('EVIV') from mirrored/deformed text, supporting the gibberish artifact. The Topology Auditor found high mask confidence, suggesting the keys themselves are coherent objects, but this does not rule out the 'muddy' mechanical linkages noted by the Router. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortion, but this is expected as the artifacts are local/structural. The severity of the text artifact (3.5) is appropriate as it indicates a likely AI generation error or a flipped image, both of which degrade quality in this context.
